title: The Ultimate Chocolate Mud Cake
description: A decadent, dense, and fudgy masterpiece topped with silky chocolate ganache — the ultimate indulgence.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 150°C (fan) or 160°C (standard). Grease and line a 20 cm round cake tin. Extend the parchment 6 cm above the tin.
Place butter and chocolate in a heatproof bowl. Microwave 1 min on high, stir, then 30 sec more. Stir until smooth and glossy, using extra 10-sec bursts if needed.
Add sugars and coffee granules, then stir in milk, eggs, and vanilla until combined.
Sift in flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt. Stir until smooth.
Pour batter into tin and bake 80–90 min, or until a skewer shows a few moist crumbs. Avoid opening oven early.
Cool in tin 20 min, then transfer to wire rack to cool completely.
Combine milk and cream in a jug and microwave ~1 min until hot but not boiling.
Pour over chopped chocolate. Let sit 5 min, then stir until smooth. Reheat briefly if needed.
Level the cooled cake with a serrated knife, then pour ganache over top and spread evenly.
Refrigerate ~2 hours or until firm. Can also set at room temperature if cool enough.
Slice and serve — even fudgier on the second day.
